question:
**Direction: Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Gala
solution:
The correct answer is "Carnival."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "Gala" means a special social or sporting occasion. (कोई विशेष सामाजिक कार्यक्रम; किसी खेल का विशेष कार्यक्रम)

 
 
• Example: *There will be many stars performing in the Royal Ballet's **Gala**__ Night.*
 
 
 
• The word that means the same as the given word is "Carnival."
 
• The word "Carnival" means a public festival that takes place in the streets with music and dancing. (आनंदोत्‍सव, जनोत्‍सव, मनोरंजन मेला)
 __
 
• Example: *There's a real **carnival**__ atmosphere in the streets.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Funeral: **a ceremony (usually religious) for burying or burning a dead person. (मृतक का अंतिम संस्‍कार)
 
• **Mistakenly: **unintentionally or inadvertently; by mistake. (अनजाने में; गलती से)
 
• **Moist: **slightly wet; damp. (हलका गीला; नम, आर्द्र)
